name: PT 5424
title: Musculoskeletal Pathology
description: Mechanical properties of musculoskeletal tissues will be described.  Growth and maintenance mechanisms of the different tissues will be detailed. Diseases and disorders of the musculoskeletal system will be covered.  The underlying tissue pathology and clinical symptoms will be addressed from the orthopedic and physical therapy perspective.  Therapeutic interventions will be presented.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
